description: This file provides functions for performing pinned file writes using a Python helper script, including fallback mechanisms. It defines types, imports modules, and contains functions to execute external processes, handle file operations, and parse identity information.

methods.name: runPinnedWriteHelper
methods.description: Executes a Python helper script to perform a pinned file write, returning the file's identity.

methods.name: runPinnedWriteFallback
methods.description: Performs a fallback file write operation if the Python helper cannot be executed.

methods.name: resolvePinnedWritePython
methods.description: Resolves the path to an executable Python interpreter from candidate paths.

methods.name: parsePinnedIdentity
methods.description: Parses the output from the Python helper to extract file identity information.
